# Recharge API

> REST API reference for Recharge, the subscription platform. Latest version: V2, previously called 2021-11. Base URL: https://api.rechargeapps.com. Authenticate with the X-Recharge-Access-Token header and select a version with X-Recharge-Version.

V2 and 2021-11 are the same version. `X-Recharge-Version: v2` and `X-Recharge-Version: 2021-11` behave identically, and everything in this reference is available with either value.
